title: Projective Time, Cayley Transformations and the Schwarzian Geometry of the Free Particle--Oscillator Correspondence
summary: We investigate the relation between the one--dimensional free particle and the harmonic oscillator from a unified viewpoint based on projective geometry, Cayley transformations, and the Schwarzian derivative.
